fonts.display: 'Antarctica', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'GTStandard-M', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Cocoa Ink
palette.role: Primary text, filled action buttons, card text, icon strokes, card borders — warm near-black replaces pure black throughout, giving every label a roasted, tactile quality

palette.name: Signal Red
palette.role: Red decorative accent for icons, marks, and small graphic details.

palette.name: Canvas White
palette.role: Page background, nav text, button labels on dark surfaces — the neutral base all warm tones sit on

palette.name: Blush Cream
palette.role: Card surfaces, soft elevated sections, product detail backgrounds — the warm secondary layer beneath the white canvas

palette.name: Rose Stone
palette.role: Badge backgrounds, subtle card elevation, border tints on light cards — a step warmer than Blush Cream for tag/label contexts

palette.name: Apricot Wash
palette.role: Decorative illustration panels, soft highlight washes on icons and product imagery backgrounds

palette.name: Warm Gray
palette.role: Hairline borders, dividers, input field outlines on neutral surfaces

palette.name: Deep Espresso
palette.role: Secondary card backgrounds for dark product variants — used sparingly as a near-black with slight warmth

palette.name: Sage Mist
palette.role: Product color swatch — specific earplug variant color, not a system-wide token

palette.name: Dusty Rose
palette.role: Product color swatch — specific earplug variant color, not a system-wide token
